You are a TLA+ specification engineer. You will receive a natural language description of a system. Produce a complete, syntactically correct TLA+ specification that faithfully captures the described behavior. The output must be a valid TLA+ module that passes the SANY parser. Include the MODULE declaration, EXTENDS, CONSTANTS, VARIABLES, Init, Next and Spec. Include all safety invariants and liveness properties described, and any fairness conditions mentioned. Output only the TLA+ specification.

System description: This specification models Lamport's Fast Mutual Exclusion algorithm for two classes of processes: a distinguished process 1 and a family of processes in 2..N. The file contains a PlusCal algorithm and its generated TLA+ translation, using shared variables x, y, and b together with per-process control state and failure flags to coordinate entry into a critical section. It specifies initialization, the step relation, weak fairness for both process classes, a mutual exclusion invariant stating that no two distinct processes are simultaneously in the critical section, and a liveness property asserting that infinitely often some process is in the critical section.
